question: How do you create read-only frozen instances with the @dataclass decorator?
expected_answer: Set frozen=True on the @dataclass decorator. Assigning to fields will then generate an exception.

evidence_spans.text: frozen: If true (the default is False), assigning to fields will generate an exception. This emulates read-only frozen instances.
